summary: Two simulated parallel pull requests (each: own work, a checkpoint update, three stage moves, a ledger line and a CHANGELOG bullet). On main 2587fe0 git merge-tree finds conflicts in .chough/session.json, .chough/transitions.jsonl, .chough/pruned.jsonl and CHANGELOG.md. On the adopted branch each writes only its own session and event files, the ledger and CHANGELOG.md union-merge, and the real merge is clean, keeping both bullets, both ledger lines and both sessions.
provenance: unauthenticated observation; not proof of human approval, test execution, or deployment
limitations: Case definitions and generated knowledge notes still conflict until the DRIVE-12 product change; spec change logs until CorvidLabs/spec-sync#862.
